purpose: Document first-party local/regional cadastral custody and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Rosreestr/NSPD cadastral-map custody is evidenced, but the bounded anonymous requests did not produce a safe native parcel ID plus full polygon. NSPD timed out; the municipal GIS exposed an administration/login page and its inspected JavaScript referenced only a regional-boundary WFS layer.
registryAssessment: The regional Rosreestr announcement identifies the NSPD public cadastral map as the public cadastral-map service available without authorization. This is cadastral-service custody evidence, not proof of current parcel geometry availability at the WUP point.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Announcement attributed to the Rosreestr administration for Belgorod Region identifies the NSPD public cadastral map and states that it is available without authorization. No parcel response was extracted from the platform in this attempt.
Official NSPD homepage; bounded GET timed out after 20 seconds.
Belgorod municipal GIS administration page; anonymous access returns a login wall.
